purpose: Screening log for the B question set (eval/README.md 9.2 E3). Items are read in seed order per category (pool.json order); an excluded item is replaced by the next position. Reasons are judged from the question text only.

reason_codes.not_in_category: not a request for a developer CLI tool, a local AI/LLM tool or an MCP server (including: the bucket's category does not match what the text actually asks for, or the text is too unclear to tell)
reason_codes.no_hard_condition: states no hard condition that can be checked against a tool's docs, license, repo or by running it (a vague wish for something 'good' or 'popular' does not count)
reason_codes.paid_or_commercial: explicitly wants paid or commercially licensed software
reason_codes.duplicate_of_q: substantially the same as one of the 20 questions in eval/questions.yaml (the matching q-id is logged)
reason_codes.personal_data: requires giving personal data (the asker's or anyone else's) to answer or to run the tool, or the post itself contains personal data
